pluginTools.operationMismatch: The operation returned a mismatched result.
pluginTools.definitionChanged: The operation definition was updated. Review the refreshed parameters, then run it again.

tools.noActivityLog: Processing events will appear here after a task starts

hints.measure_lufs: LUFS measures integrated loudness. −∞ indicates silence or a signal below the loudness measurement threshold.
hints.measure_true_peak: True peak estimates peaks between samples by oversampling; sample peak measures the original samples. Negative values are below digital full scale.
hints.measure_rms: RMS measures average signal energy. dBFS is relative to digital full scale; RMS amplitude is a linear value.

analysis.spectrumLabel: Audio spectrum, frequency on the horizontal axis and magnitude on the vertical axis
analysis.spectrumDescription: View the frequency distribution and magnitude at the start of the audio.
analysis.spectrumHint: Analyzes the first FFT-sized segment, mixing channels to mono. Magnitudes are windowed FFT values in dB, not a whole-file average spectrum or dBFS levels.
